audience: coworking and membership space operators who run members, bookings and invoices in Spacebring

useCases.title: Find invoices that are still open
useCases.text: List invoices by status, location, customer or issue date. Open one invoice for its line items, taxes and payments.

useCases.title: Check the bookings for a meeting room
useCases.text: List the bookable resources, then the bookings of one room in a date range. Open one booking for its user and price.

useCases.title: List events and attendee counts for a location
useCases.text: List events by location and date range with their attendee count. Open one event for its tickets and hosts.

useCases.title: Review member check-ins and visitor visits
useCases.text: List member check-ins and check-outs by location and time. List visitor visits with the host and status.

useCases.title: Comment on and update a support ticket
useCases.text: Read a support ticket first. Then add a comment that people who can see the ticket will read. Set its status to new, inProgress, solved or closed.
